free_tier.stated: USD 3.00 per month for the Stryx plan in New York: 1 vCPU, 1 GB DDR4 ECC, 10 GB NVMe, 500 Mbps port with 32 TB, one IPv4. Nyrex is USD 5.00 (2 vCPU / 2 GB / 30 GB), Zerix USD 8.00 (2 / 4 / 50) and Pyron USD 12.00 (4 / 8 / 70), all on the same 500 Mbps and 32 TB line. The page publishes a per-state plan list for the United States, of which Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Michigan, New York, Texas, Virginia and Washington have their own pages.

egress.terms: 32 TB a month on a 500 Mbps port, marked with an asterisk on the page; no overage price stated

chaining: 32 TB a month for USD 3.00 is the widest allowance at this price, and the per-state list means the egress point can be moved without changing provider

limits.value: 32 TB a month on a 500 Mbps port is the stated allowance; a 500 Mbps port can move about 5.4 TB a day at saturation, so the monthly byte cap binds before the port does.
